spec.description: Traffic across the production mirror gateway and the staging gateway serving Falcon, registry, and other sites. Metrics come from Mimir; completed-request access logs come from ClickHouse.

spec.title: Downstream Bandwidth
spec.description: Traffic between clients and Envoy. Egress is bytes sent to clients.

spec.title: Top HTTPRoutes
spec.description: Top 10 HTTPRoutes by completed requests in the selected time range. Labels are namespace/route-name; rules and matches are combined. Requests without an HTTPRoute are grouped as (unmatched).

spec.rawSql: SELECT if(empty(extract(LogAttributes['route_name'], '^httproute/([^/]+/[^/]+)(/|$)')), '(unmatched)', extract(LogAttributes['route_name'], '^httproute/([^/]+/[^/]+)(/|$)')) AS httproute, count() AS requests FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN ('envoy-mirror-production', 'envoy-gateway-staging') AND match(ServiceName, '-(${gateway:regex})$') GROUP BY httproute ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 10

spec.title: Response Codes
spec.description: Exact response-code distribution from access logs.

spec.rawSql: SELECT LogAttributes['response_code'] AS response_code, count() AS requests FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN ('envoy-mirror-production', 'envoy-gateway-staging') AND match(ServiceName, '-(${gateway:regex})$') GROUP BY response_code ORDER BY requests DESC

SELECT LogAttributes['method'] AS method, count() AS requests FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN ('envoy-mirror-production', 'envoy-gateway-staging') AND match(ServiceName, '-(${gateway:regex})$') GROUP BY method ORDER BY requests DESC

spec.title: Requested Hosts
spec.description: Top hostnames observed by the selected gateways.

spec.rawSql: SELECT LogAttributes['host'] AS host, count() AS requests FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN ('envoy-mirror-production', 'envoy-gateway-staging') AND match(ServiceName, '-(${gateway:regex})$') AND host != '-' GROUP BY host ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 8

spec.title: Request Rate by Replica
spec.description: Traffic distribution across selected Envoy pods.

spec.title: Active Load
spec.description: Open downstream requests and connections across the selected replicas.

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: Completed public HTTP and HTTPS requests over the last five minutes.

spec.title: OTLP Access-Log Delivery
spec.description: Envoy access-log export throughput and delivery failures.

spec.title: Slow Requests
spec.description: Latest 200 completed requests lasting at least one second, with gateway and HTTPRoute context. Large downloads can be slow without indicating a backend problem.

spec.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, if(ServiceName = 'envoy-mirror-production', 'Production', 'Staging') AS gateway, if(empty(extract(LogAttributes['route_name'], '^httproute/([^/]+/[^/]+)(/|$)')), '(unmatched)', extract(LogAttributes['route_name'], '^httproute/([^/]+/[^/]+)(/|$)')) AS httproute, toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms']) AS duration_ms, LogAttributes['response_code'] AS status, LogAttributes['method'] AS method, LogAttributes['host'] AS host, LogAttributes['path'] AS path, LogAttributes['client_ip'] AS client_ip FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN ('envoy-mirror-production', 'envoy-gateway-staging') AND match(ServiceName, '-(${gateway:regex})$') AND duration_ms >= 1000 ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

spec.title: Gateway Failures
spec.description: Latest 200 server errors and pre-HTTP connection failures, with gateway, HTTPRoute, TLS, and transport diagnostics.

spec.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, if(ServiceName = 'envoy-mirror-production', 'Production', 'Staging') AS gateway, if(empty(extract(LogAttributes['route_name'], '^httproute/([^/]+/[^/]+)(/|$)')), '(unmatched)', extract(LogAttributes['route_name'], '^httproute/([^/]+/[^/]+)(/|$)')) AS httproute, LogAttributes['response_code'] AS status, LogAttributes['method'] AS method, LogAttributes['host'] AS host, LogAttributes['path'] AS path, LogAttributes['response_flags'] AS flags, LogAttributes['response_code_details'] AS details, LogAttributes['downstream_remote_address'] AS remote_address, LogAttributes['downstream_local_address'] AS local_address, LogAttributes['filter_chain_name'] AS filter_chain, LogAttributes['requested_server_name'] AS server_name, LogAttributes['downstream_tls_version'] AS tls_version, LogAttributes['downstream_wire_bytes_received'] AS wire_bytes_received, LogAttributes['downstream_transport_failure_reason'] AS transport_error, LogAttributes['downstream_detected_close_type'] AS close_type FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN ('envoy-mirror-production', 'envoy-gateway-staging') AND match(ServiceName, '-(${gateway:regex})$') AND (toUInt16OrZero(status) = 0 OR toUInt16OrZero(status) >= 500) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
